Born 14 November 1763 and baptized at Saint Matthew’s Lutheran Church, Hanover,
on 4 March 1764, the eldest son of Jacob and Anna Barbara Winteroth.
He married Maria Magdalena Ashbaugh about 1790, and their children included Desintha,
Wilhelm and Samuel. As eldest son he settled his father’s estate from 1797.
He died without a will on 26 May 1817, aged 53, and is buried at Christ Reformed Church,
Union Township. Born in Mountjoy Township, Adams County, Pennsylvania, in August 1768,
daughter of Andreas Eschbach (Andrew Ashbaugh) and Maria Artemesia.
She married Johann Adam Winterode about 1790; her father’s will of 1813 names Adam as his son-in-law and one of his
two executors. Her brother Andrew probably married Adam’s sister Margaret.
Widowed in 1817, she handed the estate to her son William and son-in-law John Staley because she was moving away.
